## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking)
- [ ] Refactor / chore (no behaviour change)
- [ ] Docs only
- [ ] Infra / CI
- [ ] **Breaking change** (requires migration notes below)

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added / updated (or N/A with reason)
- [ ] `pytest` passes locally on SQLite
- [ ] `yarn lint` and `yarn test:unit` pass on the frontend
- [ ] Migrations: backward-compatible OR migration plan documented below
- [ ] No founder personal number / private credentials included in code, docs, or fixtures
- [ ] Incident log updated if this is a production fix
- [ ] Screenshot or screen recording attached if the UI changed
